description: tools/test-projects/pixel-fx (WEB_PROJECT=pixel-fx tools/build.sh web): S48's runtime Pixel FX in WebAssembly without pthreads, on WebGL2 (SwiftShader in the web image's headless shell), AC26. library:sprite sprites with the PIXEL4 outline and Dissolve, Dither Fade, Ramp Recolour, Drop Shadow and Hit flash under Glitch at intensity 0; a PixelFX dissolve, a Hit-Stop and a glitch burst run, then an iris Transition covers and reveals; the frame then holds with the flash's magenta at the centre.
